# Bye.DS_Store v1.0.5

## What's New

- Added confirmation before starting a full-disk cleanup.
- Added detailed scan results with failure paths and error messages.
- Added recent cleanup status and the `⌘⌥B` shortcut hint to the menu popover.
- Added restore-default and clear-all actions for exclusion rules.
- Added scan location choices for the startup disk, external disks, network disks, or all mounted volumes.
- Added an in-app language selector with System default, Chinese, and English options.
- Fixed language changes not refreshing some Settings controls until restart.
- Fixed Settings window placement to follow the screen containing the status item.
- Added DMG output and optional Developer ID signing and notarization to the release workflow.

## Notes

- Full-disk cleanup remains a manual operation.
- Without Apple Developer secrets, GitHub Releases use an ad hoc signed app.
